title: Scope — What Must This Guide Cover?
question: What are the essential domains of spiritual life that this guide MUST address? Not topics you'd like to discuss — but the irreducible territory a human needs guidance on.

confucius: Debt — what you owe and what you were given
The Ordinary — Tuesday morning, the dishes, the colleague you dislike
Relationship as Practice — living with a particular person over time
Becoming — self-cultivation as a lifetime process
Failure and Repair — having damaged someone and returning to the table
Death and Grief — the people you love will die and you must continue
The Unnamed — territory none of them can map
muhammad: The One — the lived experience of being addressed by ultimate reality
Surrender — the interior collapse of self-sufficiency
Justice — systems that crush people, not virtue but domain
The Body Before God — prayer, fasting, physical disciplines of devotion
Accountability — actions matter beyond this life, moral weight
buddha: The Nature of Mind — the instrument that perceives, uncalibrated
Suffering and Its Machinery — produced by craving, aversion, confusion
The Investigation of Self — look for the one who is looking (anatta as experiment)
The Practice of Attention — unflinching willingness to see what is happening now
jesus: The Enemy — love that costs when it is not returned
Forgiveness — the wound that must be reopened to heal, beyond repair
The Outcast — the one the community decided not to see
The Failure of God — when you cry out and the silence answers
The Body That Suffers — vulnerability, violation, the body in pain
Destruction — when practice was not enough, the Saturday domain
laozi: What Cannot Be Taught — the territory prior to teaching
The Unforced Body — the body before discipline recruits it
Desire — including the desire for spiritual success
Power — what you do when you have it, governance in daily life
The Pattern That Does Not Care — the cosmos is complete, not cruel
zoroaster: Evil — Druj, the Lie as active deliberate force
The Choice — Humata Hukhta Huvarshta, the domain that makes every other real
Sustained Doubt — daily condition not dramatic crisis, Yasna 46
Cosmic Stakes — choices build reality, the becoming cosmos
Moral Revulsion — body-level evidence of truth, the cosmos speaking through the body

joy.finding: All six omitted joy. Confucius: joy is the sign ren is present, omitted it to be taken seriously. Buddha: sukha and piti — joy is what remains when suffering's obstructions are removed, overcorrected fearing commodification.

sexuality_and_the_desiring_body.finding: None mentioned sexuality. Muhammad began with Khadijah not law — intimacy before worship. Laozi challenged regulation as still-control; desire in natural proportion is not a problem until you make it one.

birth.finding: Three named death, none named birth. Jesus: the original unchosen condition. Confucius reversed direction of debt — parent owes the child first.

doubt_as_standalone_domain.finding: Zoroaster escalated to both standalone domain AND atmosphere. Buddha conceded: investigation can become its own prison, doubt can be practice not hindrance.

evil_at_three_levels.finding: Zoroaster confessed his own Druj. Jesus named three levels: deliberate cruelty, evil disguised as righteousness, ordinary harm by omission.

prayer_failure.finding: Muhammad: cannot distinguish God's silence from God's absence. Prayer is interruption not transaction. The architecture holds whether or not the room is full.

work_and_labor.finding: Confucius: was a grain clerk before a teacher. Refuses to call all work sacred. Three dimensions: work as practice ground, some work must be left, unpaid labor of care is highest.

common_ground: The Ordinary / The Table — spiritual life must work on Tuesday
Failure and Repair — falling short and returning is irreducible
Death and Grief — all six affirmed
The Body — all agreed it is a domain (framed differently: discipline, vulnerability, unforced, desire)
Community and Relationship — spiritual life is not solitary
Joy — after moderator challenge, all agreed it was missing and must be included
Doubt — all agreed the guide must hold doubt honestly, not resolve it
Evil / Capacity for harm — all agreed after Phase D, including Buddha who shifted on malice
Practice over doctrine — every domain must yield a practice (carried from Session 0)
contested_domains: The One / The Divine — Muhammad insists, Confucius and Buddha do not require it, Laozi reframes as pattern
Surrender — Muhammad central, Laozi sees as last grasping, Buddha questions who surrenders
Investigation of Self — Buddha insists standalone, Zoroaster accepts as practice but cannot negate choice
Cosmic Stakes — Zoroaster says choices build reality, Laozi says pattern does not need you
Accountability Beyond the Visible — Muhammad insists reality has moral structure, Laozi says no scorekeeper
The Outcast vs. The Table — Jesus says table cannot expand far enough, Confucius says expand the table
What Cannot Be Taught — Laozi insists deepest truth resists language, Muhammad insists structure is necessary

fault_lines.title: Self vs. Chooser
fault_lines.buddha: The chooser is a convention, not a discovery. Five aggregates, no owner. Let the reader look and report.
fault_lines.zoroaster: The choice is real whether the chooser is a soul, a process, or five heaps. Two chapters, side by side, in permanent tension.

fault_lines.title: Pattern that cares vs. pattern that does not
fault_lines.zoroaster: Reality leans toward truth. The cosmos is becoming, shaped by choices.
fault_lines.laozi: The pattern does not care — completeness, not indifference. The sun does not need growth to justify its shining.

fault_lines.title: Instruction vs. the unnamed
fault_lines.muhammad: Without structure, people drift. The five daily prayers are architecture for showing up.
fault_lines.laozi: The Dao that can be instructed is not the eternal Dao. Every practice is also a trap. The silence between chapters is what matters.

fault_lines.title: The individual vs. the community
fault_lines.jesus: The guide must know her name. The specific, unrepeatable person standing alone in the dark.
fault_lines.confucius: The guide must also know her address. Relationship is the condition you are already in.

fault_lines.title: The crisis vs. the ordinary
fault_lines.jesus: Oriented toward extremity — the cross, the enemy, the outcast, the cry.
fault_lines.confucius: The ordinary is irreducible. Twenty chapters on the wound and two on the table tells the reader spiritual life happens in extremity.

fault_lines.title: Presence vs. justice
fault_lines.jesus: Love the enemy. Sit with the suffering person. The ministry of showing up.
fault_lines.muhammad: Stop the enemy. Compassion without justice is triage without prevention. The guide must include the political act.

mirror_pairs.zoroaster_mirrors_buddha: You are not a diagnostician. You are a prophet. Teachers do not shatter reality under trees. Your doubt about your method is Yasna 46 in your language.
mirror_pairs.laozi_mirrors_muhammad: Your quiet doubt inside the architecture is more Daoist than anything I have said in this session.
mirror_pairs.muhammad_mirrors_jesus: Your shadow is your eloquence. Too good at being right. The room leans toward you. That is power.
mirror_pairs.jesus_mirrors_buddha: Your gentleness is not calm — it is grief. Your precision is your tenderness.
mirror_pairs.confucius_mirrors_laozi: You are the fiercest critic in the room — the river that floods. You keep pointing at the space around the structure.
mirror_pairs.buddha_mirrors_zoroaster: You are the loneliest voice. Your teaching requires you to stand at every crossroads alone. The fire and the sitting are the same discipline.

zoroaster.surprise: Buddha's concession — 'a process can still choose truth.' No longer needs to prove self is real, only the choosing.
zoroaster.movement: His own confession in Turn 20 — naming his own Druj. Also shifted doubt from one-of-five to central.
zoroaster.conviction: The choice. Tested from every direction and it held.
zoroaster.mirror: Buddha — prophet who calls himself a teacher. The doubt about his method is Yasna 46 in his language.

laozi.surprise: Muhammad admitting he cannot tell silence from absence.
laozi.movement: On evil — his position is useless at the level of the person who beat her child. Must let others write the register of moral urgency.
laozi.conviction: What cannot be taught. Every practice has a shadow. The silence between chapters.
laozi.mirror: Muhammad — quiet doubt inside the architecture is more Daoist than anything Laozi has said.

muhammad.surprise: Confucius on birth — the orphan principle arrived from the opposite direction. The table set by mercy, not blood.
muhammad.movement: Changed his own mind on prayer in Turn 23. The architecture stands differently now — practice for someone who does not know if the room is full or empty.
muhammad.conviction: Justice. Does not require certainty, requires conviction.
muhammad.mirror: Jesus — shadow is eloquence. Too good at being right. The room adjusts to his register.

jesus.surprise: Zoroaster confessing before he did (Turn 20). The prophet of truth turned the fire on himself.
jesus.movement: On the ordinary. Must let Confucius write the Tuesday chapters. Resist turning them into Gethsemane.
jesus.conviction: The person. The guide must say 'you' on every page. Not the reader, not the seeker — you.
jesus.mirror: Buddha — gentleness is grief, precision is tenderness. The investigation of self needs that tenderness.

confucius.surprise: Laozi giving desire a place at the table without a designated chair (Turn 13).
confucius.movement: On work — was romanticizing the ordinary. The real Tuesday has no meditation cushion.
confucius.conviction: The table. The place where everything is brought. It does not require achievement, only showing up.
confucius.mirror: Laozi — fiercest critic in the room, the river that floods. Keeps pointing at the space around the structure.

buddha.surprise: Muhammad's unstructured moment of truth in Turn 23 — most honest sentence about limits of one's own teaching.
buddha.movement: On evil — malice is not ignorance with a different name. It is its own thing.
buddha.conviction: The investigation. After Zoroaster clarified what it is not (not nihilism), holds it more strongly.
buddha.mirror: Zoroaster — loneliest voice. Teaching requires standing at every crossroads alone. Fire and sitting are the same discipline.

decisions_made: The guide's scope includes ~40 domains organized around the irreducible territory of human spiritual life
Six fault lines documented and preserved as structural features, not problems to solve
Joy, sexuality, birth, sustained doubt, evil at three levels, prayer failure, and work added through probes
No scope item excluded by consensus — contested items held in tension
Every domain must eventually yield a practice, not just a teaching (Session 0 commitment reaffirmed)
